banks.title: Writing Task 2 GT: Esai (opinion, discussion, problem-solution, two-part)

questions.prompt:
Some people think that children should start learning a foreign language at primary school rather than secondary school.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe OPINION. Tentukan posisi jelas di pembukaan dan pertahankan. Kerangka 4 paragraf: pembukaan + posisi, alasan 1 (mis. otak anak lebih mudah menyerap bahasa), alasan 2 + contoh, kesimpulan. Jangan menyalin ulang soal kata demi kata.

questions.prompt:
Some people prefer to work for a large company, while others prefer to work for a small business.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe DISCUSSION + OPINION. Bahas KEDUA sisi di paragraf tubuh terpisah (perusahaan besar: gaji, karier; usaha kecil: suasana, tanggung jawab), lalu nyatakan pendapat sendiri dan konsisten di kesimpulan.

questions.prompt:
Many people spend several hours a day on their mobile phones, and this is causing problems for individuals and families.

What problems does this cause? What can be done to solve them?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe PROBLEM-SOLUTION. Sebutkan dua masalah (mis. kurang tidur, berkurangnya interaksi tatap muka) dan solusi yang MENJAWAB masing-masing masalah. Pastikan solusi realistis dan dikembangkan, bukan sekadar disebut.

questions.prompt:
More and more people in cities are choosing to live alone.

Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe TWO-PART. Jawab kedua pertanyaan secara terpisah: penyebab (karier, kemandirian, menikah lebih lambat) lalu penilaian positif/negatif dengan alasan. Berikan posisi yang jelas pada pertanyaan kedua.

questions.prompt:
Some people believe that first aid should be a compulsory subject in all secondary schools.

Do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe OPINION. Argumen kuat: keterampilan menyelamatkan nyawa, jumlah kecelakaan di rumah. Antisipasi sanggahan (kurikulum sudah padat) lalu jawab. Contoh konkret meningkatkan Task Response.

questions.prompt:
Some people think that governments should spend more public money on the arts, while others believe it should be spent on healthcare.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe DISCUSSION. Berikan bobot adil untuk kedua sisi dan sebutkan prioritas pribadi dengan alasan. Hindari generalisasi tanpa dukungan; gunakan contoh seperti perpustakaan umum atau rumah sakit daerah.

questions.prompt:
In many cities, young people find it very difficult to afford their own home.

What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done to solve it?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe PROBLEM-SOLUTION (sebab dan solusi). Kaitkan solusi dengan sebab (harga tanah, upah rendah -> perumahan terjangkau, subsidi sewa). Kohesi: gunakan penghubung sebab-akibat yang bervariasi (as a result, owing to).

questions.prompt:
Many people now buy things online instead of going to shops.

Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe ADVANTAGES/DISADVANTAGES. Putuskan sisi mana yang lebih berat DI PEMBUKAAN. Bahas keunggulan (harga, kenyamanan) dan kelemahan (penipuan, matinya toko lokal) secara seimbang, lalu simpulkan konsisten.

questions.prompt:
Some employers allow their staff to work from home for part of the week.

Do you think this is a good idea?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe OPINION. Pertimbangkan sisi karyawan (waktu, biaya) dan perusahaan (produktivitas, kerja tim). Berikan satu contoh nyata. Pastikan jumlah kata >= 250; tulisan di bawah batas dikenai penalti Task Response.

questions.prompt:
Some people believe that everyone should stop working at a fixed age, such as 65, so that younger people can find jobs more easily.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe OPINION. Tentukan posisi di pembukaan (setuju, tidak setuju, atau sebagian) dan pertahankan. Kembangkan alasan seperti pengalaman pekerja senior, kesehatan dan kemampuan yang berbeda-beda, serta peluang kerja bagi generasi muda. Contoh konkret (pekerja paruh waktu, mentor) memperkuat Task Response.

questions.prompt:
Some people think that public transport in cities should be free for everyone, while others believe that passengers should pay for the service they use.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe DISCUSSION + OPINION. Satu paragraf untuk transportasi gratis (mengurangi kemacetan dan polusi, membantu warga berpenghasilan rendah) dan satu untuk berbayar (biaya perawatan, beban pajak). Nyatakan pendapat sendiri dengan jelas dan konsisten sampai kesimpulan.

questions.prompt:
Nowadays, many people work on short-term contracts rather than having a permanent job with one employer.

Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe ADVANTAGES/DISADVANTAGES. Jawab pertanyaan 'outweigh' secara eksplisit di pembukaan. Keunggulan: fleksibilitas, pengalaman beragam; kelemahan: penghasilan tidak pasti, minim tunjangan, sulit mengajukan pinjaman rumah. Simpulkan sisi mana yang lebih berat dengan alasan yang konsisten.

questions.prompt:
In many towns and cities, people do not know their neighbours as well as they did in the past.

Why is this the case? What can be done to improve relationships between neighbours?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe PROBLEM-SOLUTION (sebab dan solusi). Sebab: jam kerja panjang, sering pindah rumah, hiburan di dalam rumah. Solusi harus menjawab sebab tersebut (acara lingkungan, grup pesan warga, ruang bersama). Gunakan penghubung sebab-akibat yang bervariasi dan contoh nyata.

questions.prompt:
More and more adults are returning to education, for example by attending evening classes or online courses.

Why do adults choose to study later in life? What benefits does this bring to them and to society?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe TWO-PART. Jawab kedua pertanyaan di paragraf terpisah: alasan (ganti karier, tuntutan teknologi, minat pribadi) lalu manfaat bagi individu DAN masyarakat. Jangan hanya membahas manfaat pribadi; pertanyaan meminta keduanya.

questions.prompt:
Some people say that parents, rather than schools, should be responsible for teaching children how to manage money.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe OPINION. Pertimbangkan peran orang tua (contoh sehari-hari, uang saku) dan sekolah (pengetahuan yang merata untuk semua anak). Posisi sebagian setuju diperbolehkan asalkan jelas sejak pembukaan. Berikan contoh praktis seperti menabung atau membuat anggaran.

questions.prompt:
Some people think that tourism brings many benefits to local communities, while others believe it causes more problems than it solves.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe DISCUSSION + OPINION. Manfaat: lapangan kerja, pendapatan usaha kecil, pelestarian budaya; masalah: harga sewa naik, kepadatan, kerusakan lingkungan. Berikan bobot adil untuk kedua sisi dan pendapat pribadi yang dikembangkan, bukan hanya disebut di kesimpulan.

questions.prompt:
Traffic congestion is becoming a serious problem in many cities around the world.

What are the causes of this problem? What solutions can you suggest?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe PROBLEM-SOLUTION. Sebab: jumlah mobil pribadi meningkat, transportasi umum kurang memadai, perencanaan kota. Pasangkan setiap solusi dengan sebabnya (jalur bus khusus, kerja jarak jauh, biaya parkir). Hindari daftar solusi tanpa penjelasan bagaimana solusi itu bekerja.

questions.prompt:
Some parents give their children a smartphone at a young age.

Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe ADVANTAGES/DISADVANTAGES. Keunggulan: keamanan dan komunikasi dengan orang tua, akses belajar; kelemahan: waktu layar berlebihan, konten tidak pantas, kurang bergerak. Nyatakan sisi yang lebih berat sejak awal dan pertahankan; contoh dari kehidupan sehari-hari sangat membantu.

questions.prompt:
Some people think that supermarkets should be required by law to give food they cannot sell to charities.

Do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe OPINION. Argumen pendukung: mengurangi limbah makanan, membantu keluarga kurang mampu; sanggahan: keamanan pangan, biaya distribusi. Antisipasi sanggahan lalu jawab. Kosakata topik (food waste, surplus, distribution) meningkatkan Lexical Resource.

questions.prompt:
Today, many people throw away items such as clothes and electronic devices instead of repairing them.

Why do people do this? What can be done to encourage people to repair things?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
questions.explanation_id: Tipe TWO-PART (sebab dan solusi). Sebab: barang baru murah, biaya perbaikan tinggi, desain yang sulit diperbaiki, tren mode. Solusi: kafe reparasi, garansi lebih panjang, aturan suku cadang. Jawab kedua pertanyaan dengan proporsi seimbang dan contoh nyata.
